name: Daily Digest API — for the Lovable dashboard

parameters.content:
## Digest API (read-only)
GET /webhook/digest returns the last 14 days of morning items + evening statuses from the Data Table, plus the evaluation numbers typed into the **Eval numbers (edit me)** node. The Lovable dashboard reads this one URL.
